name: @embeddablecut/web
description: The EmbeddableCut editor app: FreeCut's browser editor on the Svelte UI, served as a static PWA, and the headless harness page.

scripts.format: vp fmt app.ts headless.ts vite.config.ts package.json
scripts.format:check: vp fmt app.ts headless.ts vite.config.ts package.json --check
scripts.perf: vp run build:perf && vp run preview:perf
scripts.check:fix: vp check app.ts headless.ts vite.config.ts package.json --fix
